name: Novice Ash-er
designer: 2013 USFG SSC. No individual designer named on the source sheet.
notes: Declared on the sheet, as cross-checks not source of truth: 49 facets, 8-fold mirror symmetry. Step cut on both sides - crown is two concentric bands plus an octagonal table, pavilion is two bands plus eight triangles to a point culet. Sheet states no material, size or girdle tolerance; the source diagram measures the girdle at 3.23% of width. Tier order differs from the sheet, which lists the crown first (C1 C2 T G P1 P2 P3): the girdle must precede P2 because a fraction needs two named vertices and P1 alone leaves only its axial point, and pavilion-before-crown avoids cutting the crown to a temporary point and then removing it, which wastes material. NOT EXPRESSIBLE: the crown and pavilion middle band boundaries sit at the same radius in the source diagram (both at plate y=666.0), i.e. the steps line up in plan view. That is a condition on the result, not a position, so the two fraction rows record the positions that satisfy it and lose the intent. The percentages are diagram-derived; tidy values (25/25/33.3) were tested and miss the drawing by 0.2-0.6%, outside its precision. Source: 'GemCad Diagrams - 53 designs.pdf' p34, 'Faceting Diagrams/USFG Competitions/2013SSCNovice.gem'. Angles and indices transcribed from the sheet; meets derived from its crown, pavilion and profile diagrams.
